name: tokenizen-net-guard
description: The single enforced egress choke-point for the tokenizen trust layer: an IP-validating, IP-pinning fetch and DNS resolver that refuses private, loopback, link-local and cloud-metadata addresses on every hop, including redirects. Published as tokenizen-net-guard because npm rejects the name net-guard as too similar to the existing netguard package.
author: holistis
